### ST-014

**Command framework, global flags and help**

*As a **developer**, I want **a consistent `smarttest <command>` interface with discoverable help**, so that **I can learn the tool from the terminal**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S1 | §26.2, §26.4 | [ST-003](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-003), [ST-008](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-008) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Global flags `--config --workspace --json --quiet --verbose --non-interactive --dry-run --help` are parsed uniformly
- [x] Unknown commands/flags exit 2 with a 'did you mean' suggestion
- [x] `smarttest --version` and `smarttest help <command>` work
- [x] Warm startup for `--help` is under 300 ms on the reference machine

---

### ST-015

**Output modes for humans and machines**

*As a **CI maintainer**, I want **colored, compact output in a TTY and plain/JSON output elsewhere**, so that **the same command works locally and in pipelines**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S1 | §26.5 | [ST-014](CLI-cli-developer-experience.md#st-014) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Non-TTY output contains no ANSI codes or spinners and never prompts
- [x] `--json` prints exactly one JSON document on stdout; logs go to stderr
- [x] `NO_COLOR` and `FORCE_COLOR` are respected

---

### ST-016

**Interactive root menu**

*As a **developer new to SmartTest**, I want **`smarttest` with no arguments to show a searchable menu of common actions**, so that **I don't have to memorise commands**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟧 Should | 5 | S8 | §26.3 | [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063), [ST-071](INI-smart-init.md#st-071) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Menu shows workspace name, status and the actions: run affected, generate architecture, coverage & reports, diagnostics, settings
- [x] Arrow keys, Enter and `/` search work; Esc exits
- [x] In non-TTY or `--non-interactive`, `smarttest` prints help and exits 0

---

### ST-017

**Progress and diagnostics renderer**

*As a **developer**, I want **clear progress for long steps and structured, actionable errors**, so that **I always know what SmartTest is doing and how to fix problems**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S2 | §26.5 | [ST-015](CLI-cli-developer-experience.md#st-015) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Long-running phases render a task list with durations
- [x] Errors print code, message, hint and docs link; `--verbose` adds the cause chain
- [x] Warnings are summarised at the end of a command

---

### ST-018

**`smarttest scan` command**

*As a **developer**, I want **a read-only command that shows what SmartTest understands about my project**, so that **I can verify detection and indexing before trusting selection**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 2 | S3 | §26.2 | [ST-019](DET-project-detection.md#st-019), [ST-037](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-037) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Prints project profile, VCS state, file/symbol/edge counts and unresolved imports
- [x] `--json` output is schema-versioned
- [x] Never writes outside `.smarttest/`
